subject.title: bundle-mcp: remote streamable-http server connects but tools never materialize for a Pi agent (2026.5.7)

question: Should this older streamable-http Pi-agent report stay open until current-version proof is supplied, or is the sandbox/doctor/docs evidence enough for maintainers to close it as resolved by existing diagnostics?
rationale: The code and related reports identify plausible fixes and explanations, but the issue lacks the current effective sandbox policy and has no latest-release retry for the exact bearer-authenticated streamable-http server.

options.title: Require Current-Version Proof
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for current main or v2026.6.11 doctor, sandbox policy, mcp probe, and trajectory evidence before closing or queueing a fix.

options.title: Close As Sandbox-Diagnostics Resolved
options.body: Close only if maintainers accept the missing sandbox allow entry as the intended root cause despite the issue not showing that config.

options.title: Fold Into A Narrow Canonical
options.body: Move any remaining no-tools symptom into a more specific canonical issue after the reporter identifies whether the current failure is sandbox policy, toolFilter naming, or catalog/materialization.

recommendation.title: Require Current-Version Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for current main or v2026.6.11 doctor, sandbox policy, mcp probe, and trajectory evidence before closing or queueing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest ownership trail for the MCP transport/materialization boundary points to this contributor, and the decision needs that runtime context.
